title: Mystic Spell Shop Vision
description: A surreal fantasy still life shows an open ancient book glowing with a swirling green vortex on its pages, placed on a cloth-covered table with scattered rose petals, purple candles dripping wax, a blue potion bottle labeled 'Eye of Vision', scales with a green crystal, and a black dish. Dominating the background is a giant stylized eye containing a cosmic green spiral galaxy with a bright cyan center, set against a purple wall with hanging scrolls and herbs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy still life on a cloth-covered table featuring an open ancient spellbook with glowing green spiral vortex pages, blue glass potion bottle labeled Eye of Vision with red wax seal, dripping purple candle with red wax, golden scales holding a green crystal, black dish, and scattered red and white rose petals. A massive stylized all-seeing eye with a swirling cosmic green galaxy and bright cyan center floats in the background above the table against a purple wall with hanging scrolls and dried herbs, intricate details, mystical atmosphere
